design_notes: Enumerate all 64 configurations across every eligible common-input stratum; do not use a half fraction unless observed resource limits justify it.

The 720-entry historical directory ledger has 46,080 directory/configuration planning slots, not requirement-level trials or independent observations. All full specialist cells remain unexecuted; preserve partial component receipts separately.
Do not infer eligibility from catalogue existence; distinguish source, rights, structure, component/runtime, format applicability, and independent reference readiness.

Where a specialist is genuinely not applicable (e.g. image-layout recovery on native structured XML), record structural nonapplicability or a stratum-specific valid full factorial; do not silently run an identity operation and claim a treatment effect.

Define low and high as competing executable methods when estimating method effects; match candidates, novel evidence, scope, accepted coverage and actual resource constraints; separate optional-stage inclusion and resource contrasts.

Cross candidate generation with ranking at equal pools and novel evidence, separate full-universe recall and conditional ranking. Treat formal gates as invariant; compare advisory selective routing and counterexample placement only.

Block by family and document; balance feasible orders; predeclare reference, harm, missingness, actual costs and interaction estimands before confirmatory runs. Cache only exact input/model/configuration hashes; never copy predictions to new states.

analysis.primary: paired factorial contrasts and per-family effects on independent common inputs, plus fixed-budget risk/coverage and multiobjective cost
analysis.uncertainty: family-level Bayesian bootstrap for descriptive reweighting; Bayesian hierarchical models or GLMM with family and case effects and random slopes when enough independent families; prior sensitivity and posterior predictive checks
analysis.prediction: Compare beta-smoothed arm mean, regularised regression, Bayesian random effects, XGBoost using whole-family outer folds and nested tuning only on qualified development families; assess Brier/log loss, calibration, paired routing regret, actual resource and review cost.
analysis.confirmation: no hyperparameter selection on exposed held-out families; independent frozen families and locked references; preserve every outcome and avoid treating configurations as independent cases.
